visualCharacteristics.purpose: Auto-advancing slides with text left and image right, selected by labelled progress-bar tabs
notes: Cream background; each slide = gold eyebrow "Our Tracks", uppercase h2, body text, dark pill "Read more" on the left, large image on the right; below, three labels (Accelerate Progress / Embedding Value / Enhancing Quality of Life) with timed progress bars select the slide.

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide: cell 1 = image, cell 2 = eyebrow paragraph + h2 + paragraph + CTA link; the h2 also labels the slide tab
patterns: labelled progress-bar tabs under the slides
blockContent: 3 slides (Accelerate Progress, Embedding Value, Enhancing Quality of Life), each eyebrow + h2 + text + Read more link to a detail page + image; labelled progress-bar navigation

usage.description: A small set (2-4) of themed highlights with a read-more link each.

reuseGuidance: Use for text + image slides with labelled tabs. Use carousel-hero-video for full-bleed video hero slides, columns-media for static image/text rows.
